a: The capital of Nigeria is Abuja.
Lagos is Nigeria's largest city and main economic hub.
The currency of Nigeria is the Naira (NGN).
English is the official language; many local languages are widely spoken.
Nigeria uses West Africa Time (WAT, UTC+1) year-round.
Nigeria has 36 states plus the Federal Capital Territory.
Nigeria is the most populous country in Africa.
Nigeria borders Benin, Niger, Chad, and Cameroon.
The national anthem begins with 'Arise, O Compatriots' (current version as adopted).
